install_steps: Initialize: jira init (select Cloud or Local, enter Jira URL and credentials)
Export JIRA_API_TOKEN env var (for Cloud) or use password/PAT (for Server)
note: Also available as downloadable binary from GitHub Releases: https://github.com/ankitpokhrel/jira-cli/releases. Cloud users need an API token from https://id.atlassian.com/manage-profile/security/api-tokens. Use --no-input to skip interactive prompts and --raw for JSON output.
